3. Eligibility criteria and essential qualification: A candidate, as on the last date of
submission of online application, must fulfill the following criteria:
[2]
1.

Must be an indigenous inhabitant of the State of Nagaland belonging to the
District of Mokokchung, Tuensang and Phek.
Must possess the minimum educational qualification of Class-VII (7th) standard;
and those who have passed HSSLC (12th) or above shall be ineligible to apply for
the said post. On need basis, preference may be given to the candidates having
special skill.
4. Selection Process:
Written examination:50 marks
Written examination(Objective type multiple choices) will be 11/2
hour(ninety minutes) duration on OMR sheet and the same will contain
questions on General Knowledge/Current Affairs, General English and
General Mathematics of Class VII standard.
Stage-I
r v
Candidates equal to 5 times the number of vacancies (1:5) in order of
merit in the written examination will be called to appear in the
Interview/Viva-Voce and verification of documents. A candidate must
secure at least 60% i.e, 12 out of 20 marks in the Interview/Viva-Voce
in order to be considered qualified.
Stage-II
Final selection will be made on the basis of the total marks obtained by the candidates in the
written examination and Interview/Viva-Voce. Where more than one candidate obtains same grand
total marks, the candidate who obtains more marks in the written examination will get preference.
Where the marks obtained by such candidates in the written examination are also same, then the
candidate who is senior in age will get preference. The High Court reserves the right to assign any
Group-D position(s) to the selected candidates based on administrative requirement. The Gauhati
High Court reserves the right to fix or alter the cut off mark in written examination and
Interview/Viva-Voce.
5. HOW TO APPLY
Before applying online, candidates must possess a valid e-mail ID and Mobile Number
which are mandatory for registration. E-mail ID should be kept active. Though the
system is designed to send e-mail immediately acknowledging the
Registration Code, sometimes due to network congestion, the e-mail may not
be delivered, hence the candidates are requested to note down the
Registration Code.
I. Log on through the websites https://kohimahiqhcourt.gov.in/ and click on 'Online

9. TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
i Merely satisfying the eligibility criteria will not entitle a candidate to be called for
the written examination/Viva-Voce etc.
[51
//Z Candidates have to upload scanned copies of their documents/testimonials rather
than submitting physical copies at the time of submission of online application.
However, candidates have to produce their original testimonials regarding
educational qualifications claim of reservation, certificate of indigenous inhabitant
of the District, Permanent Resident Certificate , date of birth, caste, working
experience(if applicable,) etc. at subsequent stages when asked for.
Number of posts may vary at the time of final selection on either side.
No person, who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a
spouse living or who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a
marriage with any person, shall be eligible for appointment to the aforementioned
posts
The admission of candidates at all stages of the selection process shall be purely
provisional and subject to their satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria. If, on
verification at any time before or after the selection process, it is found that a
candidate does not fulfill any of the eligibility conditions, his/her candidature shall
stand cancelled without any notice. Mere calling of candidate to the written
examination/Interview etc. or issuance of admits cards/call letter etc, does not
mean acceptance of candidature of any candidate which shall be further
scrutinized at every stage and the High Court reserves the right to reject the
candidature of any candidate at any time.
The provisional list of the candidates, with assigned Roll Nos. will be published in
the High Court websites/District Court websites for the candidates’ reference.
No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for appearing in the written
examination/Viva-Voce etc.
For candidate’s reference, answer keys of the question paper for the written
examination will be made available in the Official websites after the examination.
Candidates who are already in the Government Service in State/Central/PSU may
apply after intimating their employers regarding submission of online application
forms for the advertised vacancies. They shall have to produce **No Objection
Certificate" from their present employer at the time of document verification and
"Release Order" at the time of appointment.
The High Court may decide not to issue any admit card/call letter etc. to any
candidate and may decide to call candidates to written examination/Viva-Voce etc.
by publishing a notification in the official website and notice board of the High
Court/ District Court. Candidates are advised to visit the Official website
(https://kohimahighcourt.gov.in/) of the High Court/District Court regularly for
updates and important information. Unnecessary correspondence should be
avoided .
Application form, which is incomplete in any respect, such as without the
photograph and signature, is liable to be rejected summarily, unless otherwise
decided by the High Court.
The candidates, before applying for the posts, should ensure that they fulfill all
the eligibility conditions. Any information submitted by an applicant in his/her
application will bind the candidate personally. The candidate will be solely
responsible for any mistake made by him/her in the application form and the High
Court shall not be responsible or liable in any way.
